state.paragraph: On September 19, 2013, the Special Committee held an in-person meeting. By invitation of the Special Committee, Mr. MacDonald and Mr. Shea, as well as representatives from BofA Merrill Lynch and Goodwin Procter, were also present for all or portions of the meeting. At this meeting, BofA Merrill Lynch updated the Special Committee as to the current status of the revised indications of interest submitted by Party A, Party B and CSC/Pamplona and reported that Party C did not submit a revised indication of interest or reiterate its prior indication of interest. BofA Merrill Lynch also reported to the Special Committee on Mr. MacDonald's general support for continuing with the process and his view that Mac-Gray should continue to seek a higher value for stockholders. Mr. Shea again reviewed the Projections with the Special Committee and BofA Merrill Lynch. The Special Committee again discussed the Projections, including the risks relating to Mac-Gray's ability to execute its strategic plan as an independent, stand-alone company (including Mac-Gray's ability to identify, acquire and successfully integrate laundry facilities management businesses, establish new and/or renew existing laundry facility management leases and penetrate markets historically dominated by smaller
state.target_sentence: Mr. Shea again reviewed the Projections with the Special Committee and BofA Merrill Lynch.

criteria.row_34: 09/11/2013 | Stewart G. MacDonald, Jr. (CEO) | Other material event | Rollover refused by holder: CEO and major holder says he won't roll over shares. BofA reports bidders unlikely to proceed without his support; committee has him fully briefed (09/12). He backs the process, wants higher value.
criteria.row_35: 09/11/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Round opened | BofA calls all four the same day asking for final IOIs by 09/18/2013. Short exclusivity offered to one bidder depending on price and deal certainty.
criteria.row_36: 09/18/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 20.75 | Final-round proposal, up from $19.50 (#28); Formal as a response to the final solicitation. Pamplona commits 100% of the capital; only confirmatory diligence followed (Light). Requests 2-week exclusivity.
criteria.row_37: 09/18/2013 | Party A | Bid reaffirmed | price 18-19 | By phone to BofA: confirms #31 as its best and final offer, answering the final solicitation. The 09/10 bid had no firm financing commitment and none is reported since (Heavy).
criteria.row_38: 09/18/2013 | Party B | Bid | price 21.5 | Party B values its bid at $21.50: $19.00 cash plus options for 10% of new equity, which it values at $2.50 and which vest on a five-year target. Debt-and-equity financing, no commitment reported (Heavy).
criteria.row_39: 09/18/2013 | Party C | Did not submit | Did not submit or reaffirm its $16.00-$17.00 IOI (#32) and gave no reason. Reported on 09/19; not seen again.
criteria.row_40: 09/18/2013 | Mac-Gray | Deadline | Due date for final IOIs, reached. On 09/19 the committee acted on the bids in hand (enforced).
criteria.row_41: 09/19/2013 | Mac-Gray (Special Committee) | Other material event | Preferred bidder and price requirement: CSC/Pamplona is best on value, certainty and risk (Party B's options and financing riskier). Exclusivity offered at $21.25; MacDonald supports $21.25.
criteria.row_42: 09/21/2013 | CSC/Pamplona | Bid | price 21.25 | Raised from $20.75 (#35) the same day the committee asked. Conditioned on 2-week exclusivity; asks for voting agreements from MacDonald. Pamplona funds 100%, no financing contingency; confirmatory diligence only (Light).
criteria.row_45: by 09/24/2013 | Party B | Dropped by target | Inferred date: displaced by exclusivity with CSC/Pamplona. Reason from the committee on 09/19: Party B's options were contingent and deferred, and its financing riskier, despite the higher face value.
criteria.none: None of the ledger rows records the event reported in the target sentence, either as the row's own event or in its note.
criteria.not_an_event: The target sentence reports no discrete event of these kinds (background, reasoning, description or discussion only).

match.instructions: `target_sentence` (from a merger filing; `paragraph` gives context) appears to report that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Each option describes one row of a research ledger as date | party | event | note. Select the row that records the event reported in `target_sentence`: same party or group, same action, consistent date and terms, allowing paraphrase and allowing the event to be summarised in a row's note. A related event with a different party, date or action does not count.
